Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting‑edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Unit 42

The Team Unit 42 - Unit 42 is our global threat intelligence team, and our mission is to provide customers with the context, analysis, and assistance they need to protect themselves from the most sophisticated cyber threats. We are on the front lines of cyber security, researching and hunting for the latest threats and providing that intelligence to our customers and the broader community. Our team is a group of world‑renowned security researchers, incident responders, and security consultants who are at the forefront of the fight to prevent successful cyberattacks.
Principal Consultant

As a Principal Consultant on the Offensive Security team, you will be a key leader in assessing and challenging the security posture of a diverse client portfolio. You will leverage a variety of advanced tools and methodologies to act as the client’s advocate for cybersecurity best practices. This role is critical in providing strong, actionable recommendations to enhance our clients’ defenses against sophisticated threats.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead conducting comprehensive penetration tests (network, web application, cloud, mobile) to identify and exploit vulnerabilities.
• Deliver assessments using Palo Alto Networks Frontier AI Defense test harnesses and platforms using the latest frontier models.
• Develop custom scripts, tools, and methodologies to automate and enhance offensive security engagements and internal processes.
• Lead client engagements, clearly articulating testing approaches and methodologies to both technical and executive audiences.
• Generate detailed reports that communicate test results, identified risks, and concrete remediation recommendations to clients.
• Proactively collaborate with internal teams and clients, exchanging information to ensure alignment and accomplish shared security objectives.
• Lead in scoping new opportunities and developing internal infrastructure for offensive security research and development.
• Ability to travel as needed to meet business demands.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 6+ years of professional experience in information security, with a focus on penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
• Expertise with security assessment tools such as Metasploit, Burp Suite Pro, Cobalt Strike, Nessus, and Bloodhound.
• Proficiency in scripting or programming with languages like Python, PowerShell, Ruby, or C++.
• Demonstrated experience in conducting penetration tests across various environments including Windows, Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience managing or mentoring junior consultants on security engagements.
• Demonstrated interest in LLM‑driven offensive security.
• Certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, GWAPT, or GXPN.
• Experience with public speaking, publishing research, or contributing to the security community.
Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

DWT Technology is seeking a Senior VAPT Consultant to perform end-to-end vulnerability assessment and penetration testing for infrastructure and web applications in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires hands-on testing, strong technical reporting, and direct client communication.

The ideal candidate will have proven VAPT experience, familiarity with OWASP Top 10, business logic testing, and readiness to work on-site in Saudi Arabia. Immediate to 1 week availability is preferred.

Cybersecurity Consultant – VAPT / Penetration Testing

Company: Centillion Hub Ltd
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Job Type: Full-Time | Onsite
Salary: Up to SAR 18,000 per month
Experience: 3–4 Years
Nationality: Open to All (Saudi Nationals Preferred)
Gender: Any
Vacancies: 1
Hiring Status: Urgent

Centillion Hub Ltd is urgently seeking a skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Consultant – VAPT / Penetration Testing to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), application security assessments, and identifying security vulnerabilities across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and IT infrastructure.

The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting security assessments, analyzing vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and recommending remediation measures to improve clients' cybersecurity posture.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications (Android and iOS), and APIs.

• Perform black-box and gray-box security assessments.

• Identify, validate, and document security vulnerabilities using manual and automated testing techniques.

• Conduct external attack-surface discovery, reconnaissance, and asset enumeration.

• Perform authorized penetration testing in accordance with industry-recognized methodologies.

• Assess application security against OWASP standards and cybersecurity best practices.

• Prepare detailed technical reports, executive summaries, and remediation recommendations.

• Classify security findings using CVSS and prioritize vulnerabilities based on severity and business impact.

• Conduct remediation retesting to verify the effectiveness of implemented security fixes.

• Collaborate with technical teams and clients to communicate findings and recommend security improvements.

• Support source code security reviews and internal network security assessments when required.

• Maintain proper testing documentation and ensure assessments follow agreed scope and authorization requirements.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3–4 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, or application security.

• Strong hands-on experience in web application, mobile application, and API penetration testing.

• Practical understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP WSTG, OWASP ASVS, and OWASP Mobile Security Testing methodologies.

• Familiarity with penetration testing tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit, and OWASP ZAP.

• Understanding of networking protocols, authentication mechanisms, common application vulnerabilities, and security controls.

• Experience in black-box and gray-box testing methodologies.

• Ability to document security findings and provide clear, actionable remediation recommendations.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Good communication and technical reporting skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple security assessments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as OSCP, CEH, eWPT, or equivalent.

• Experience in source code security assessments.

• Knowledge of Active Directory security testing and internal network penetration testing.

• Familiarity with NIST SP 800-115, PTES, OSSTMM, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.

• Experience working with enterprise clients or cybersecurity consulting firms.

• Arabic and English communication skills.

Salary & Benefits

• Monthly Salary: Up to SAR 18,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

• Work Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

• Work Arrangement: Full-time, onsite.

• Open Position: 1.

How to Apply

Interested candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply through Indeed with an updated CV highlighting their cybersecurity experience, penetration testing projects, technical expertise, and relevant certifications.
